name: OBIC Co.,Ltd.
summary: OBIC Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides system integration, system support, and office automation services in Japan. It offers consulting and system planning, system design and analysis, program development, implementation and operational support, network security design, and other related solutions for various industries, as well as OBIC7, an enterprise resource planning solution; and education and training support services. The company also engages in the sale of personal computers, communication equipment, and other system peripherals, as well as office furniture; office planning and interior construction; network support; and business package software.
